purpose: Reduce repeated human↔agent permission reconstruction by carrying one explicit, bounded, attenuating delegation lease across replaceable workers without creating a new authority plane or allowing privilege growth.

position.selection: SOURCE → HOLD still selects the exact object and lawful native moves
position.delegation: An explicit issuer-supplied lease may pre-authorize a class of TURNs within named scope and conditions.
position.execution: Native host still owns EFFECT/commit. This contract never executes anything.
position.closure: Every allowed TURN still TRACEs and RETURNs. The lease does not create NEXT or priority.

laws: NO LEASE MAY BE INFERRED FROM MODEL MEMORY, TASK STATE, TRANSPORT SESSION, OR THE ABSENCE OF AN OBJECTION.
Live lease bytes are authority-bearing and PRIVATE by default. Do not commit real leases to a public repository; publish only the contract and sanitized examples.

This reducer validates lease structure and scope, not issuer authenticity. Untrusted/remote transport requires host-authenticated provenance or a cryptographically verifiable issuer before operational use.
A lease can preserve or reduce issuer authority; it can never enlarge it.
Lease scope is explicit across principal, action, resource, side-effect ceiling, reversibility and time.
Unknown or out-of-scope requests ESCALATE; explicit denies and expired/revoked leases DENY.
ALLOW means only that the request matches the supplied lease. The native host must still accept and perform the operation.
A2A/MCP task or transport state is not operation authorization.
v0.1 leases are NON_DELEGABLE: an agent cannot mint a broader child lease or transfer the lease to another principal unless the issuer explicitly names that principal.
Each TURN keeps SOURCE → HOLD → TURN → TRACE → RETURN semantics; repeated permission prompts may be reduced, evidence and RETURN may not.

If authorization rules require groups, inheritance, rich contextual predicates, remote identity, revocation distribution or policy composition, stop extending this format and use a real policy engine such as Cedar or OPA.

lease_semantics.lease_id: Stable issuer-selected identifier for check-back and RETURN references.
lease_semantics.issuer: Object with kind + ref. It identifies the claimed authority source; the reducer does not authenticate it. Operational hosts must establish issuer authenticity independently.
lease_semantics.issued_at: ISO timestamp recorded by the issuer/caller.
lease_semantics.expires_at: Optional ISO expiry. Expired leases DENY.
lease_semantics.principals: Explicit worker/crew identifiers or '*'. No implicit transitive membership.
lease_semantics.resources: Exact strings or simple '*' globs over addressed objects/routes/repositories.
lease_semantics.allow_actions: Explicit action tokens pre-authorized by the issuer.
lease_semantics.deny_actions: Explicit hard denies; deny wins over allow.
lease_semantics.side_effect_ceiling: Maximum effect class allowed by this lease.
lease_semantics.require_reversible: When true, request.reversible must be true or the request ESCALATEs.
lease_semantics.stop_conditions: Caller-supplied request flags that force ESCALATE before EFFECT.

decision_semantics.ALLOW: Request matches every lease dimension and no stop/deny condition. Native host authority is still required.
decision_semantics.ESCALATE: Lease is valid but the request is outside/unknown relative to its scope. Obtain fresh explicit authorization or narrow the request.
decision_semantics.DENY: Lease is expired, revoked, non-delegable contract is violated, or action is explicitly denied. Do not proceed under this lease.

check_back.purpose: Closed-loop confirmation for human + replaceable workers.
check_back.law: Critical scope is repeated back in concrete terms; silent assumption is not agreement.

interop.agents_md: Discovery/worker instructions. Does not itself grant runtime operation authority.
interop.mcp: Tool/resource transport. Explicit lease/request data may travel over MCP only with host-trusted issuer provenance; transport/session state is not a lease.
interop.a2a: Task transport between opaque agents. AUTH_REQUIRED or task continuation is not operation authorization; untrusted peers cannot self-issue an accepted lease.
interop.cedar_opa: Preferred replacement when this minimal PARC-like reducer would otherwise grow into a policy language.
interop.temporal: A durable workflow may persist an issuer-approved lease and wait for escalations, but workflow liveness is not authorization.

return.next_authority: NONE unless the same still-valid lease is explicitly re-presented and re-evaluated for the next request.
